column1: # entry_months: semicolon-separated month numbers (e.g. "11;12" = Nov+Dec only)
#               leave empty to scan all months
# min/max_days_in_trade: window duration range in calendar days
# stop_pct: Max Adverse Excursion % — filters out windows with large intra-trade drops
# win_rate_threshold: minimum % of years that must be profitable
# max_consec_losses: maximum allowed consecutive losing years
